display.description: RSI-14 falls below 30 — price in oversold territory

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: RSI has fallen into oversold territory, meaning recent selling pressure is unusually strong and a bounce or reversal becomes more likely.
info.fires: Triggers when RSI(14) drops below the threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold RSI sits (deeper = stronger).
info.bestFor: Mean-reversion entries inside ranges. Pairs well with support proximity or bullish divergence.
info.watchOut: In strong downtrends RSI can stay <30 for many bars; lower the threshold or reduce the weight when ADX is high and trending down.

threshold.description: RSI oversold boundary in 0–100 index points; RSI below this value triggers. Example: 30.

display.description: RSI-14 rises above 70 — price in overbought territory

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: RSI has climbed into overbought territory, meaning recent buying pressure is unusually strong and a pullback or reversal becomes more likely.
info.fires: Triggers when RSI(14) rises above the threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold RSI sits (higher = stronger).
info.bestFor: Mean-reversion shorts inside ranges. Pairs well with resistance proximity or bearish divergence.
info.watchOut: In strong uptrends RSI can stay >70 for many bars; raise the threshold or reduce the weight when ADX is high and trending up.

threshold.description: RSI overbought boundary in 0–100 index points; RSI above this value triggers. Example: 70.

display.description: Price makes lower lows while RSI makes higher lows — hidden bullish strength

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Price prints a lower low while RSI prints a higher low — hidden bullish strength as selling exhausts.
info.fires: Triggers when current price < previous price AND current RSI > previous RSI. Score scales with how strong the indicator-vs-price gap is.
info.bestFor: Reversal entries at support after extended downmoves. Strongest when combined with oversold RSI.
info.watchOut: Divergences can persist for several bars before reversing — use as a setup confirmation, not a standalone entry.

display.description: Price makes higher highs while RSI makes lower highs — weakening momentum

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Price prints a higher high while RSI prints a lower high — momentum weakening despite new price highs.
info.fires: Triggers when current price > previous price AND current RSI < previous RSI. Score scales with how strong the indicator-vs-price gap is.
info.bestFor: Reversal entries at resistance after extended upmoves. Strongest when combined with overbought RSI.
info.watchOut: Persistent uptrends can print multiple bear divergences before topping — don't fade strong trends on divergence alone.

display.description: MACD line crosses above signal line — bullish momentum shift

moduleDisplay.description: Moving Average Convergence Divergence — trend-following momentum via fast/slow EMA spread.

info.detects: MACD histogram has just flipped from negative to positive — fast momentum overtaking slow momentum.
info.fires: Triggers when current histogram > 0 AND previous histogram <= 0. Score scales with current histogram magnitude vs. the prior bar.
info.bestFor: Trend-continuation longs after a pullback inside an established uptrend.
info.watchOut: In choppy ranges MACD whipsaws across zero frequently — combine with ADX or trend filter to avoid noise.

display.description: MACD line crosses below signal line — bearish momentum shift

moduleDisplay.description: Moving Average Convergence Divergence — trend-following momentum via fast/slow EMA spread.

info.detects: MACD histogram has just flipped from positive to negative — fast momentum losing to slow momentum.
info.fires: Triggers when current histogram < 0 AND previous histogram >= 0. Score scales with current histogram magnitude vs. the prior bar.
info.bestFor: Trend-continuation shorts after a rally inside an established downtrend.
info.watchOut: Range-bound markets produce frequent false cross-overs — pair with a trend filter (ADX or higher-timeframe direction).

display.description: Price makes lower lows while MACD makes higher lows — bullish reversal signal

moduleDisplay.description: Moving Average Convergence Divergence — trend-following momentum via fast/slow EMA spread.

info.detects: Price makes a lower low while MACD histogram makes a higher low — selling momentum exhausting.
info.fires: Triggers when price decreases but MACD histogram increases bar-over-bar. Score scales with the histogram-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: Confirming reversal setups at structural support after a downtrend.
info.watchOut: A single bar of divergence is weak — look for two or three consecutive divergent bars before sizing up.

display.description: Price makes higher highs while MACD makes lower highs — bearish reversal signal

moduleDisplay.description: Moving Average Convergence Divergence — trend-following momentum via fast/slow EMA spread.

info.detects: Price makes a higher high while MACD histogram makes a lower high — buying momentum exhausting.
info.fires: Triggers when price increases but MACD histogram decreases bar-over-bar. Score scales with the histogram-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: Confirming reversal setups at structural resistance after an uptrend.
info.watchOut: Strong parabolic moves can print divergences for many bars before topping — don't front-run momentum on a single signal.

display.description: Stochastic %K falls below 20 — oversold zone

moduleDisplay.description: Stochastic oscillator — momentum exhaustion detection from %K/%D zone position and crosses.

info.detects: Stochastic %K and %D are both deep in the oversold zone — short-term selling extreme.
info.fires: Triggers when both %K AND %D < threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold the lower of the two sits.
info.bestFor: Fast mean-reversion in ranging markets — Stochastic is more sensitive than RSI.
info.watchOut: High noise rate on lower timeframes; raise the threshold or pair with a regime filter.

threshold.description: Stochastic K oversold boundary in 0–100 oscillator points; K below this value triggers. Example: 20.

display.description: Stochastic %K rises above 80 — overbought zone

moduleDisplay.description: Stochastic oscillator — momentum exhaustion detection from %K/%D zone position and crosses.

info.detects: Stochastic %K and %D are both high in the overbought zone — short-term buying extreme.
info.fires: Triggers when both %K AND %D > threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold the higher of the two sits.
info.bestFor: Fast mean-reversion shorts in ranging markets.
info.watchOut: In strong uptrends Stochastic stays pinned >80 for extended periods — combine with trend regime context.

threshold.description: Stochastic K overbought boundary in 0–100 oscillator points; K above this value triggers. Example: 80.

display.description: %K crosses above %D below 30 — bullish crossover from oversold

moduleDisplay.description: Stochastic oscillator — momentum exhaustion detection from %K/%D zone position and crosses.

info.detects: %K crosses above %D while still inside the oversold zone — early reversal signal from a stretched low.
info.fires: Triggers when %K > %D (prev was %K <= %D) AND %D < zoneThreshold. Score scales with how deep inside the zone the cross occurred.
info.bestFor: Capturing early turns from short-term oversold conditions.
info.watchOut: A single cross is weak confirmation; combine with structure (support, divergence) for higher conviction.

zoneThreshold.description: Maximum stochastic D value, in 0–100 oscillator points, for a bullish K-over-D cross. Example: 30.

display.description: %K crosses below %D above 70 — bearish crossover from overbought

moduleDisplay.description: Stochastic oscillator — momentum exhaustion detection from %K/%D zone position and crosses.

info.detects: %K crosses below %D while still inside the overbought zone — early reversal signal from a stretched high.
info.fires: Triggers when %K < %D (prev was %K >= %D) AND %D > zoneThreshold. Score scales with how deep inside the zone the cross occurred.
info.bestFor: Capturing early turns from short-term overbought conditions.
info.watchOut: False crosses are common — pair with resistance proximity or divergence for confirmation.

zoneThreshold.description: Minimum stochastic D value, in 0–100 oscillator points, for a bearish K-under-D cross. Example: 70.

display.description: Volume spikes significantly above recent average — strong market participation

moduleDisplay.description: Volume surges, dry-ups, and OBV divergences — conviction behind price moves.

info.detects: Current volume is well above its recent average — institutional or breakout participation.
info.fires: Triggers when current volume / average volume > multiplier. Score scales with how far above the multiplier the ratio sits.
info.bestFor: Confirming breakouts, breakdowns, and impulse moves — volume validates intent.
info.watchOut: Volume surge is direction-agnostic (Neutral). Always pair with a directional signal to know which side benefits.

multiplier.description: Minimum current-to-average volume ratio; unitless multiplier where 2 means twice average volume. Example: 2.

display.description: Volume contracts well below recent average — low conviction environment

moduleDisplay.description: Volume surges, dry-ups, and OBV divergences — conviction behind price moves.

info.detects: Current volume is well below average — accumulation, distribution, or apathy phase.
info.fires: Triggers when current volume / average volume < multiplier. Score scales with how far below the multiplier the ratio sits.
info.bestFor: Identifying consolidation phases before a volatility expansion (combine with Bollinger Squeeze).
info.watchOut: Low volume reduces signal reliability across all indicators — treat dry-up as a waiting signal, not an entry trigger.

multiplier.description: Maximum current-to-average volume ratio; unitless multiplier where 0.5 means half average volume. Example: 0.5.

display.description: Price makes lower lows while OBV makes higher lows — accumulation divergence

moduleDisplay.description: Volume surges, dry-ups, and OBV divergences — conviction behind price moves.

info.detects: Price prints a lower low while OBV prints a higher low — accumulation under cover of falling price.
info.fires: Triggers when price decreases but OBV increases bar-over-bar. Score scales with the OBV-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: Spotting smart-money accumulation before retail recognizes the floor.
info.watchOut: OBV is a cumulative measure — a single bar of divergence is noisy. Look for sustained divergence over 3+ bars.

display.description: Price makes higher highs while OBV makes lower highs — distribution divergence

moduleDisplay.description: Volume surges, dry-ups, and OBV divergences — conviction behind price moves.

info.detects: Price prints a higher high while OBV prints a lower high — distribution under cover of rising price.
info.fires: Triggers when price increases but OBV decreases bar-over-bar. Score scales with the OBV-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: Spotting smart-money distribution before retail recognizes the top.
info.watchOut: OBV jumps with high-volume bars; one anomalous bar can produce a misleading divergence. Confirm over multiple bars.

display.description: ATR increasing — volatility expanding, larger price swings expected

moduleDisplay.description: ATR expansion and contraction — regime shifts in price-range dynamics.

info.detects: Current ATR is expanding meaningfully over the prior bar — volatility regime shifting up.
info.fires: Triggers when ATR / prevATR > multiplier. Score scales with how far above the multiplier the ratio sits.
info.bestFor: Validating breakouts — volatility expansion confirms a real range break versus a false flush.
info.watchOut: Expansion is direction-agnostic; loosen stop-loss range when this fires to avoid premature exits.

multiplier.description: Minimum current-to-previous ATR ratio; unitless multiplier where 1.5 means current ATR is 1.5× previous ATR. Example: 1.5.

display.description: ATR decreasing — volatility compressing, potential breakout building

moduleDisplay.description: ATR expansion and contraction — regime shifts in price-range dynamics.

info.detects: Current ATR is contracting meaningfully — volatility coiling, often preceding an expansion move.
info.fires: Triggers when ATR / prevATR < multiplier. Score scales with how far below the multiplier the ratio sits.
info.bestFor: Pre-positioning ahead of breakout setups; pair with Bollinger Squeeze for confluence.
info.watchOut: Contraction also means slower fills and wider effective spread. Don't over-size during low-ATR periods.

multiplier.description: Maximum current-to-previous ATR ratio; unitless multiplier where 0.7 means current ATR is 70% of previous ATR. Example: 0.7.

display.description: Bands contracting to multi-period narrow — breakout setup forming

moduleDisplay.description: Bollinger squeeze, band touches, and CCI extremes — volatility-relative price position.

info.detects: Bollinger Band bandwidth has collapsed — historically low volatility, expansion is statistically imminent.
info.fires: Triggers when bandwidth / middle < bandwidthPct. Score scales with how far below the threshold the bandwidth is.
info.bestFor: Pre-breakout positioning; combine with directional bias to pick the exit side.
info.watchOut: Squeezes are direction-agnostic — they tell you a move is coming, not which way.

bandwidthPct.description: Maximum Bollinger bandwidth as a decimal price ratio; 0.04 represents 4%. Example: 0.04.

display.description: Price touches or pierces lower Bollinger Band — oversold extreme

moduleDisplay.description: Bollinger squeeze, band touches, and CCI extremes — volatility-relative price position.

info.detects: Price has reached or pierced the lower Bollinger Band — short-term oversold relative to local volatility.
info.fires: Triggers when %B < pctBThreshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold %B sits, capped at 1.00.
info.bestFor: Mean-reversion long entries when price stretches the lower band in a range.
info.watchOut: In strong downtrends price can 'walk the band' lower for many bars — don't fade strong momentum on touch alone.

pctBThreshold.description: Maximum Bollinger %B ratio for a lower-band touch; 0 is the lower band. Example: 0.05.

display.description: Price touches or pierces upper Bollinger Band — overbought extreme

moduleDisplay.description: Bollinger squeeze, band touches, and CCI extremes — volatility-relative price position.

info.detects: Price has reached or pierced the upper Bollinger Band — short-term overbought relative to local volatility.
info.fires: Triggers when %B > pctBThreshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold %B sits, capped at 1.00.
info.bestFor: Mean-reversion short entries when price stretches the upper band in a range.
info.watchOut: In strong uptrends price can 'walk the band' higher for many bars — don't fade strong momentum on touch alone.

pctBThreshold.description: Minimum Bollinger %B ratio for an upper-band touch; 1 is the upper band. Example: 0.95.

display.description: CCI falls below −100 — commodity channel oversold condition

moduleDisplay.description: Bollinger squeeze, band touches, and CCI extremes — volatility-relative price position.

info.detects: CCI has fallen below the oversold floor — extended downside extreme.
info.fires: Triggers when CCI < threshold (default -100). Score scales with how far below the threshold CCI sits, capped at 1.00.
info.bestFor: Confirming oversold conditions on assets that whipsaw RSI; CCI is less smoothed.
info.watchOut: CCI is unbounded and noisy — pair with structure (support, divergence) before acting.

threshold.description: Maximum Commodity Channel Index value, in CCI index points, for an oversold reading. Example: -100.

display.description: CCI rises above 100 — commodity channel overbought condition

moduleDisplay.description: Bollinger squeeze, band touches, and CCI extremes — volatility-relative price position.

info.detects: CCI has risen above the overbought ceiling — extended upside extreme.
info.fires: Triggers when CCI > threshold (default +100). Score scales with how far above the threshold CCI sits, capped at 1.00.
info.bestFor: Confirming overbought conditions on volatile assets where RSI under-reacts.
info.watchOut: In strong uptrends CCI can stay >100 for many bars — combine with resistance or divergence.

threshold.description: Minimum Commodity Channel Index value, in CCI index points, for an overbought reading. Example: 100.

display.description: EMA 5 > EMA 13 > EMA 20 — full bullish EMA stack alignment

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Short, medium, and long EMAs stack in bullish order (EMA5 > EMA13 > EMA20) — clean uptrend structure.
info.fires: Triggers when ema5 > ema13 > ema20. Score scales with the percentage gap between the fastest and slowest EMA, capped at 1.0.
info.bestFor: Trend-confirmation gate before entering any long. Strongest when ADX is also trending.
info.watchOut: Alignment is a state, not a trigger — it can persist for many bars. Don't use it alone for timing.

display.description: EMA 5 < EMA 13 < EMA 20 — full bearish EMA stack alignment

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Short, medium, and long EMAs stack in bearish order (EMA5 < EMA13 < EMA20) — clean downtrend structure.
info.fires: Triggers when ema5 < ema13 < ema20. Score scales with the percentage gap between the slowest and fastest EMA, capped at 1.0.
info.bestFor: Trend-confirmation gate before entering any short. Strongest when ADX is also trending.
info.watchOut: Alignment is a state, not a trigger — combine with a fresh trigger (cross, divergence, structure) for entry timing.

display.description: Faster EMA crosses above slower EMA — bullish momentum crossover

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: EMA5 has just crossed above EMA13 — short-term trend flipping bullish.
info.fires: Triggers when the 5/13 EMA cross is classified Bullish by the cross-detection service. Fixed score of 0.7.
info.bestFor: Fresh trend-initiation entries when combined with EMA alignment forming.
info.watchOut: In choppy ranges 5/13 EMAs cross frequently and produce whipsaws — filter with ADX or higher-timeframe trend.

display.description: Faster EMA crosses below slower EMA — bearish momentum crossover

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: EMA5 has just crossed below EMA13 — short-term trend flipping bearish.
info.fires: Triggers when the 5/13 EMA cross is classified Bearish by the cross-detection service. Fixed score of 0.7.
info.bestFor: Fresh trend-initiation shorts when combined with bear EMA alignment forming.
info.watchOut: Range conditions produce false crosses — combine with structural break or trend filter.

display.description: Price trading above SMA-200 — long-term bullish market structure

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Price trades above the 200-period SMA — long-term bullish regime.
info.fires: Triggers whenever price > SMA200. Score scales with the percentage gap (capped, divided by 5).
info.bestFor: A long-term bias filter — only take longs while this fires for a conservative agent.
info.watchOut: Slow indicator; provides regime context, not timing. Pair with a fast trigger for entries.

display.description: Price trading below SMA-200 — long-term bearish market structure

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Price trades below the 200-period SMA — long-term bearish regime.
info.fires: Triggers whenever price < SMA200. Score scales with the percentage gap (capped, divided by 5).
info.bestFor: Long-term bias filter for shorts; useful as a "no longs" guard in bear regimes.
info.watchOut: Provides regime context, not timing. Combine with a fast trigger for execution.

display.description: ADX above 25 — directional trend active with meaningful strength

moduleDisplay.description: ADX above/below threshold — trending versus ranging regime classification.

info.detects: ADX is high enough to indicate a meaningful trending regime — momentum strategies favored.
info.fires: Triggers when ADX > threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold ADX sits.
info.bestFor: Gate to enable trend-following signals (alignment, crosses) and disable mean-reversion in the same window.
info.watchOut: ADX is direction-agnostic — it confirms a trend exists, not which side. Pair with EMA alignment for direction.

threshold.description: Minimum Average Directional Index value, in ADX points, for a trending market. Example: 25.

display.description: ADX below 20 — price in range-bound, low-trend environment

moduleDisplay.description: ADX above/below threshold — trending versus ranging regime classification.

info.detects: ADX is low — market is range-bound, mean-reversion strategies favored.
info.fires: Triggers when ADX < threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold ADX sits.
info.bestFor: Gate to enable mean-reversion signals (Bollinger touches, RSI/MFI extremes) inside ranging markets.
info.watchOut: Low ADX can precede strong breakouts — combine with Bollinger Squeeze to detect imminent regime change.

threshold.description: Maximum Average Directional Index value, in ADX points, for a ranging market. Example: 20.

display.description: Funding rate at extreme positive levels — long crowding, reversal risk elevated

moduleDisplay.description: Perpetual funding extremes and rate flips — derivatives-side positioning sentiment.

info.detects: Perpetual funding rate is extremely positive — longs are paying shorts heavily, crowded long positioning.
info.fires: Triggers when the funding rate carried out to a year (the ann column) is above thresholdAnnualizedPct. Score scales with how far above the threshold it sits, reaching 1.00 at twice the threshold.

examples.scenario: rate = 0.00025 per hourly settlement (219% a year)
rate = 0.000125 per hourly settlement (109.5% a year)
rate = 0.0001 per hourly settlement (87.6% a year)

info.bestFor: Contrarian setups — extreme positive funding often precedes long squeezes.
info.watchOut: During strong uptrends funding can stay extreme for many funding intervals; don't fade a strong trend on funding alone.

thresholdAnnualizedPct.description: Annualized funding-rate threshold in percent, the unit of the ann column; the signal fires above it. 100 means 100% a year. Example: 100.

display.description: Funding rate at extreme negative levels — short crowding, squeeze risk elevated

moduleDisplay.description: Perpetual funding extremes and rate flips — derivatives-side positioning sentiment.

info.detects: Perpetual funding rate is extremely negative — shorts are paying longs heavily, crowded short positioning.
info.fires: Triggers when the funding rate carried out to a year (the ann column) is below -thresholdAnnualizedPct. Score scales with how far below it sits, reaching 1.00 at twice the threshold.

examples.scenario: rate = -0.00025 per hourly settlement (-219% a year)
rate = -0.000125 per hourly settlement (-109.5% a year)
rate = -0.0001 per hourly settlement (-87.6% a year)

info.bestFor: Contrarian setups — extreme negative funding often precedes short squeezes.
info.watchOut: In strong downtrends funding can stay extreme; pair with structural support or bullish divergence.

thresholdAnnualizedPct.description: Annualized funding-rate magnitude in percent, the unit of the ann column; the signal fires below its negative. 100 means -100% a year. Example: 100.

display.description: Funding rate direction reversing — sentiment shift in progress

moduleDisplay.description: Perpetual funding extremes and rate flips — derivatives-side positioning sentiment.

info.detects: Funding rate has just flipped sign — directional positioning is unwinding or rotating.
info.fires: Triggers when current rate has opposite sign vs. previous rate. Fixed score of 0.6.
info.bestFor: Identifying positioning resets — useful as a "stop fading the trend" signal in confluence with price action.
info.watchOut: Funding flips often happen near tops and bottoms but also during noise around zero — context matters.

display.description: Open interest rising sharply — new capital entering the market

moduleDisplay.description: OI surges and OI/price divergences — capital flow into versus out of positions.

info.detects: Open interest is increasing rapidly — fresh capital entering the market, conviction rising.
info.fires: Triggers when (oi - prevOi) / prevOi > thresholdPct. Score scales with the percentage above threshold, reaching 1.00 at twice the threshold and capped there.
info.bestFor: Validating that a move has real participation — OI surge + price move = real signal; OI flat + price move = thin tape.
info.watchOut: Surges happen during both trend continuations and liquidation cascades. Pair with directional context.

thresholdPct.description: Minimum open-interest increase as a decimal ratio; 0.05 represents 5%. Example: 0.05.

display.description: Price declining while OI rises — potential short squeeze setup

moduleDisplay.description: OI surges and OI/price divergences — capital flow into versus out of positions.

info.detects: Price falls while open interest rises — short accumulation, often preceding a squeeze.
info.fires: Triggers when price decreases but OI increases bar-over-bar. Score scales with OI vs. price magnitude, capped at 1.0.
info.bestFor: Anticipating short squeezes — combine with negative funding extreme for high-conviction longs.
info.watchOut: OI growth could be new shorts OR new longs hedging — confirm with CVD or funding direction.

display.description: Price rising while OI declines — potential long liquidation setup

moduleDisplay.description: OI surges and OI/price divergences — capital flow into versus out of positions.

info.detects: Price rises while open interest falls — longs taking profit, weak rally without fresh capital.
info.fires: Triggers when price increases but OI decreases bar-over-bar. Score scales with OI vs. price magnitude, capped at 1.0.
info.bestFor: Identifying weak rallies that lack conviction — strong fade signal at resistance.
info.watchOut: OI can fall on settlements and rolls — confirm divergence is sustained, not a one-bar artifact.

display.description: PPO crosses above signal line — price percentage momentum turning positive

moduleDisplay.description: PPO crosses and ROC sign changes — momentum relative to a benchmark.

info.detects: PPO histogram has just flipped positive — coin's relative momentum overtakes BTC's.
info.fires: Triggers when PPO histogram > 0 AND previous histogram <= 0. Score scales with current histogram magnitude.
info.bestFor: Rotation trades — identifying alts that are starting to outperform BTC.
info.watchOut: Relative strength is comparative — a bullish cross can fire while both BTC and the coin are falling, just less.

display.description: PPO crosses below signal line — price percentage momentum turning negative

moduleDisplay.description: PPO crosses and ROC sign changes — momentum relative to a benchmark.

info.detects: PPO histogram has just flipped negative — coin's relative momentum loses to BTC's.
info.fires: Triggers when PPO histogram < 0 AND previous histogram >= 0. Score scales with current histogram magnitude.
info.bestFor: Rotation signals — flagging alts to avoid or short relative to BTC.
info.watchOut: Both can rally and a bear cross still fires; this signal is about ratio, not absolute direction.

display.description: Rate of Change crosses above zero — accelerating upward momentum

moduleDisplay.description: PPO crosses and ROC sign changes — momentum relative to a benchmark.

info.detects: Relative rate-of-change is positive AND accelerating — coin gaining ground vs. BTC bar-over-bar.
info.fires: Triggers when ROC > 0 AND ROC > prevROC. Score = ROC / 5.
info.bestFor: Confirming momentum entries — both positive and accelerating filters out weak ratio moves.
info.watchOut: ROC can chop near zero; one bar of decel breaks the streak. Don't use as a standalone trigger.

display.description: Rate of Change crosses below zero — accelerating downward momentum

moduleDisplay.description: PPO crosses and ROC sign changes — momentum relative to a benchmark.

info.detects: Relative rate-of-change is negative AND accelerating downward — coin losing ground vs. BTC bar-over-bar.
info.fires: Triggers when ROC < 0 AND ROC < prevROC. Score = |ROC| / 5.
info.bestFor: Confirming weakness shorts — pairs well with bear PPO cross.
info.watchOut: One bar of stabilization breaks the streak; not a standalone trigger.

display.description: Price near a key lower-edge support level — potential bounce zone

moduleDisplay.description: Proximity to and breaks of the Donchian channel's edges — structural levels.

info.detects: Price has approached the nearest lower-edge support level.
info.fires: Triggers when |price - donchianLower| / price < proximityPct. Score scales with how close the touch is.
info.bestFor: Reversal long entries — pair with bullish divergence or OB approach for confluence.
info.watchOut: Support is a zone, not a line — wide stops below the level are safer than tight ones.

proximityPct.description: Maximum distance above support as an absolute decimal price ratio; 0.005 represents 0.5%. Example: 0.005.

display.description: Price near a key upper-edge resistance level — potential rejection zone

moduleDisplay.description: Proximity to and breaks of the Donchian channel's edges — structural levels.

info.detects: Price has approached the nearest upper-edge resistance level.
info.fires: Triggers when |price - donchianUpper| / price < proximityPct. Score scales with how close the touch is.
info.bestFor: Reversal short entries — pair with bearish divergence or OB approach for confluence.
info.watchOut: Resistance is a zone — use wider stops above the level than precise sniper stops.

proximityPct.description: Maximum distance below resistance as an absolute decimal price ratio; 0.005 represents 0.5%. Example: 0.005.

display.description: Price breaks below established support — bearish breakdown signal

moduleDisplay.description: Proximity to and breaks of the Donchian channel's edges — structural levels.

info.detects: Price has just broken below a lower-edge support level — structural breakdown.
info.fires: Triggers when the last closed price is below the PRIOR 20-period low — the lower edge of the window ending at the previous bar, which excludes this bar. Score scales with break magnitude, capped at 1.

examples.scenario: price still inside the prior range

info.bestFor: Continuation shorts in downtrends; combine with volume surge to confirm real participation.
info.watchOut: False breaks are common at psychological levels — wait for a close beyond the level, not just a wick.

display.description: Price breaks above established resistance — bullish breakout signal

moduleDisplay.description: Proximity to and breaks of the Donchian channel's edges — structural levels.

info.detects: Price has just broken above a upper-edge resistance level — structural breakout.
info.fires: Triggers when the last closed price is above the PRIOR 20-period high — the upper edge of the window ending at the previous bar, which excludes this bar. Score scales with break magnitude, capped at 1.

examples.scenario: price still inside the prior range

info.bestFor: Continuation longs in uptrends; combine with volume surge to validate the break.
info.watchOut: False breakouts at round numbers are common — require a confirmed close, not just an intra-bar wick.

display.description: Money Flow Index above 80 — buying pressure at extreme

moduleDisplay.description: Money Flow Index — volume-weighted RSI detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Money Flow Index has climbed into overbought territory, meaning recent buying pressure (price × volume) is unusually high.
info.fires: Triggers when MFI(14) rises above the threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold MFI sits (capped at 100).
info.bestFor: Mean-reversion shorts against extended uptrends; volume-weighted, so less noisy than RSI in low-volume bars.
info.watchOut: In persistent uptrends MFI can stay >80 for many bars — raise the threshold or reduce the weight.

threshold.description: Money Flow Index overbought boundary in 0–100 index points; MFI above this value triggers. Example: 80.

display.description: Money Flow Index below 20 — selling pressure at extreme

moduleDisplay.description: Money Flow Index — volume-weighted RSI detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Money Flow Index has fallen into oversold territory — recent selling pressure (price × volume) is unusually high.
info.fires: Triggers when MFI(14) drops below the threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold MFI sits.
info.bestFor: Mean-reversion longs after selling exhaustion, especially in low-volume capitulation conditions.
info.watchOut: In strong downtrends MFI can stay <20 for many bars — lower the threshold or pair with structural support.

threshold.description: Money Flow Index oversold boundary in 0–100 index points; MFI below this value triggers. Example: 20.

display.description: Price makes lower lows while MFI makes higher lows — hidden buying pressure

moduleDisplay.description: Money Flow Index — volume-weighted RSI detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Price prints a lower low while MFI prints a higher low — money flow strengthening despite price weakness.
info.fires: Triggers when price decreases but MFI increases bar-over-bar. Score scales with the MFI-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: Confirming reversals at support — volume-weighted divergence is more meaningful than RSI divergence in thin tape.
info.watchOut: Single-bar divergences are noisy; look for sustained 3+ bar divergence for higher conviction.

display.description: Price makes higher highs while MFI makes lower highs — hidden selling pressure

moduleDisplay.description: Money Flow Index — volume-weighted RSI detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Price prints a higher high while MFI prints a lower high — money flow weakening despite price strength.
info.fires: Triggers when price increases but MFI decreases bar-over-bar. Score scales with the MFI-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: Confirming distribution at resistance — combine with volume dry-up for high-conviction shorts.
info.watchOut: Parabolic uptrends can divergence for many bars before topping — don't front-run strong momentum.

display.description: MFI holding above 50 across consecutive bars — persistent accumulation pressure (Strategy London)

moduleDisplay.description: Money Flow Index — volume-weighted RSI detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: MFI(14) is above 50 on the current and previous bar — capital is flowing in consistently (accumulation zone, the CMF zero-cross equivalent using MFI data).
info.fires: Triggers when mfi > 50 and prevMfi > 50. Score scales linearly with distance above 50 (capped at 80, score = 1.0).
info.bestFor: Strategy London (accumulation phase) — confirms sustained buy-side money flow between OB extremes.
info.watchOut: Does not fire on the first bar crossing 50 — requires two consecutive bars above the midline.

display.description: MFI holding below 50 across consecutive bars — persistent distribution pressure (Strategy Berlin)

moduleDisplay.description: Money Flow Index — volume-weighted RSI detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: MFI(14) is below 50 on the current and previous bar — capital is flowing out consistently (distribution zone).
info.fires: Triggers when mfi < 50 and prevMfi < 50. Score scales linearly with distance below 50 (capped at 20, score = 1.0).
info.bestFor: Strategy Berlin (distribution phase) — confirms sustained sell-side money flow between OS extremes.
info.watchOut: Does not fire on the first bar crossing below 50 — requires two consecutive bars below the midline.

display.description: Coin outperforming or underperforming its sector peers significantly

moduleDisplay.description: Sector-peer divergence/momentum and BTC decorrelation — cross-asset relative behavior.

info.detects: The coin's direction diverges from its sector peers — outperforming or underperforming the basket.
info.fires: Triggers when divergent peer count >= peers.length * minPeerFraction. Score = divergentCount / peers.length.
info.bestFor: Spotting leaders that detach from a weak sector or laggards that miss a sector rally.
info.watchOut: Bias is dynamic — divergence direction depends on the price action vs. peers; can swing either way.

minPeerFraction.description: Minimum fraction of sector peers with the opposite trend; unitless 0–1 ratio where 0.5 means 50%. Example: 0.5.

display.description: Correlation with BTC weakening — coin moving independently of market leader. Inactive when evaluating BTC itself.

moduleDisplay.description: Sector-peer divergence/momentum and BTC decorrelation — cross-asset relative behavior.

info.detects: Correlation to BTC is weakening — coin is moving independently of the market leader.
info.fires: Triggers when BTC correlation < maxCorrelation. Score grows toward 1 as correlation drops further below the threshold.
info.bestFor: Identifying narrative-driven moves or rotations where BTC isn't leading. Useful for alt-only strategies.
info.watchOut: Neutral by default — pair with a directional signal to know which way the decorrelation favors.

maxCorrelation.description: Maximum Pearson-style correlation to BTC on the -1 to 1 scale; lower values are more decorrelated. Example: 0.3.

display.description: Sector peers showing coordinated momentum in the same direction

moduleDisplay.description: Sector-peer divergence/momentum and BTC decorrelation — cross-asset relative behavior.

info.detects: Sector peers show coordinated momentum in the same direction — a sector-wide move.
info.fires: Triggers when aligned peer count >= peers.length * minPeerFraction. Score = alignedCount / peers.length.
info.bestFor: Riding sector rotations — strong aligned momentum across peers signals durable directional flow.
info.watchOut: Aligned sector momentum can mark the late stage of a move — combine with extremes (RSI, MFI) to gauge maturity.

minPeerFraction.description: Minimum fraction of sector peers sharing the target trend; unitless 0–1 ratio where 0.6 means 60%. Example: 0.6.

display.description: Higher-timeframe regime trend direction changing across recent classified periods

moduleDisplay.description: Composite regime classification — trend, volatility, and momentum alignment shifts.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe trend direction has just shifted across recent classified periods (up / down / ranging).
info.fires: Triggers when current trend differs from prior trend in the trajectory window. Score = 1.0 (now) or 0.5 (recent shift one window back).
info.bestFor: Catching the start of a new regime, before trend-following indicators confirm.
info.watchOut: Shifts can be transient — confirm with EMA alignment or ADX before committing capital.

display.description: Higher-timeframe regime volatility level shifting across recent classified periods

moduleDisplay.description: Composite regime classification — trend, volatility, and momentum alignment shifts.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe volatility level has just shifted across recent classified periods (expanding / contracting / normal).
info.fires: Triggers when current volatility classification differs from prior. Score = 1.0 (now) or 0.5 (recent shift one window back).
info.bestFor: Adjusting risk sizing — volatility expansion = wider stops needed; contraction = breakout setup brewing.
info.watchOut: Direction-agnostic; always pair with a directional signal for entries.

display.description: Higher-timeframe trend and momentum signals pointing in the same direction

moduleDisplay.description: Composite regime classification — trend, volatility, and momentum alignment shifts.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe trend and momentum point the same way — a directional regime, amplified when volatility is expanding.
info.fires: Triggers when trend and momentum agree directionally — both bullish, or both bearish. Volatility is no part of the trigger: it only amplifies the score, which is 1.0 when volatility is expanding and 0.7 otherwise.

examples.scenario: trend up, momentum bullish, volatility expanding
trend down, momentum bearish, volatility normal

examples.outcome: does not fire — trend and momentum disagree
does not fire — a ranging trend agrees with neither momentum side

info.bestFor: Filter for high-conviction setups — only take positions when trend and momentum agree.
info.watchOut: Volatility never gates this signal, so a trend-plus-volatility agreement with momentum disagreeing does not fire. Full agreement is also rare and often appears late in trends — be aware of mean-reversion risk after extended runs.

display.description: Higher-timeframe trend and momentum signals pointing in opposing directions

moduleDisplay.description: Composite regime classification — trend, volatility, and momentum alignment shifts.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe trend and momentum dimensions disagree — conflicting signals in the higher-timeframe regime.
info.fires: Triggers when momentum diverges from trend OR there's explicit trend-momentum conflict. Score = 1.0 (diverging) or 0.6 (conflict).
info.bestFor: Caution signal — useful as a "reduce size or skip" gate before entries.
info.watchOut: Divergence can resolve in either direction; don't use it as a directional trigger.

display.description: Price approaching a Fair Value Gap — imbalance fill opportunity

moduleDisplay.description: Fair-Value Gaps, Order Blocks, and zone clusters/confluence — institutional-level structure.

info.detects: Price is approaching an unfilled Fair Value Gap — an imbalance zone likely to attract a fill move.
info.fires: Triggers when the closest active FVG distance <= proximityPct. Score = 1 - (distance / proximityPct).
info.bestFor: Pre-positioning before liquidity fills — bias direction depends on whether the FVG sits above or below price.
info.watchOut: FVGs can be ignored in strong trends; pair with regime context for confidence.

proximityPct.description: Maximum distance from an active fair-value gap in percentage points; 1 means 1%. Example: 1.

display.description: Price approaching an Order Block — institutional level reaction zone

moduleDisplay.description: Fair-Value Gaps, Order Blocks, and zone clusters/confluence — institutional-level structure.

info.detects: Price is approaching an active Order Block — an institutional reaction zone.
info.fires: Triggers when the closest active OB distance <= proximityPct. Score = 1 - (distance / proximityPct).
info.bestFor: High-quality reversal entries — institutional levels tend to produce sharp, low-noise reactions.
info.watchOut: OBs eventually break — once price closes past one, it inverts. Reset stops accordingly.

proximityPct.description: Maximum distance from an active order block in percentage points; 1 means 1%. Example: 1.

display.description: Multiple structure zones clustered nearby — high-confluence area

moduleDisplay.description: Fair-Value Gaps, Order Blocks, and zone clusters/confluence — institutional-level structure.

info.detects: Multiple structure zones (FVG + OB + swings) cluster nearby — a high-confluence zone.
info.fires: Triggers when at least 2 zones sit within rangePct of price. Score = nearbyZones.length / 3 (capped at 1.0).
info.bestFor: High-conviction reversal entries — multiple confluencing zones produce stronger reactions.
info.watchOut: Clusters can also act as liquidity magnets and get swept — combine with momentum context.

rangePct.description: Maximum zone-midpoint distance from price in percentage points for cluster membership; 2 means 2%. Example: 2.

display.description: FVG and Order Block zones overlapping — strongest structure level

moduleDisplay.description: Fair-Value Gaps, Order Blocks, and zone clusters/confluence — institutional-level structure.

info.detects: A Fair Value Gap and an Order Block overlap — the strongest possible structure level.
info.fires: Triggers when the best zone overlaps with another within alignmentPct. Score = 1.0 (exact, <0.05%) or 0.8 (aligned).
info.bestFor: Top-tier reversal setups — overlapping FVG+OB is the highest-quality structural level.
info.watchOut: Even premium levels break in strong trends — always combine with directional confluence.

alignmentPct.description: Maximum FVG-to-order-block midpoint separation in percentage points; 0.5 means 0.5%. Example: 0.5.

display.description: Cumulative Volume Delta trending positive — buy-side execution dominating

moduleDisplay.description: Cumulative buy/sell-pressure imbalance — taker-side aggression accumulation.

info.detects: Cumulative Volume Delta is positive — net aggressive buyers dominate the tape.
info.fires: Triggers when CVD > 0. Score = 1.0 if rising, 0.5 if flat.
info.bestFor: Confirming long entries — positive aggressive flow validates upward price moves.
info.watchOut: CVD measures aggression, not absorption. A positive but stalling CVD into resistance often precedes a top.

display.description: Cumulative Volume Delta trending negative — sell-side execution dominating

moduleDisplay.description: Cumulative buy/sell-pressure imbalance — taker-side aggression accumulation.

info.detects: Cumulative Volume Delta is negative — net aggressive sellers dominate the tape.
info.fires: Triggers when CVD < 0. Score = 1.0 if falling, 0.5 if flat.
info.bestFor: Confirming short entries — negative aggressive flow validates downward price moves.
info.watchOut: A negative-but-flattening CVD into support often signals seller exhaustion.

display.description: Price declining while CVD rises — hidden buy-pressure divergence

moduleDisplay.description: Cumulative buy/sell-pressure imbalance — taker-side aggression accumulation.

info.detects: Price prints a lower low while CVD prints a higher low — sellers losing aggression despite new price lows.
info.fires: Triggers when price decreases but CVD increases bar-over-bar. Score scales with CVD-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: High-conviction reversal longs at structural support — order-flow divergences are among the cleanest signals.
info.watchOut: CVD is exchange-specific; a single-venue divergence may not reflect aggregate market sentiment.

display.description: Price rising while CVD falls — hidden sell-pressure divergence

moduleDisplay.description: Cumulative buy/sell-pressure imbalance — taker-side aggression accumulation.

info.detects: Price prints a higher high while CVD prints a lower high — buyers losing aggression despite new price highs.
info.fires: Triggers when price increases but CVD decreases bar-over-bar. Score scales with CVD-vs-price gap.
info.bestFor: High-conviction reversal shorts at structural resistance — buyer exhaustion is often subtle but decisive.
info.watchOut: CVD reflects venue-level flow; verify against aggregate spot/perp data on the most liquid venue.

display.description: Higher-timeframe RSI(14) below 30 — oversold on the higher timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe RSI has fallen into oversold territory — durable, slower mean-reversion setup.
info.fires: Triggers when HTF RSI < threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold HTF RSI sits.
info.bestFor: Swing reversal entries — HTF oversold lasts longer and produces larger moves than LTF oversold.
info.watchOut: HTF signals update slowly — pair with an LTF trigger (cross, divergence, structure) for entry timing.

threshold.description: Higher-timeframe RSI oversold boundary in 0–100 index points; RSI below this value triggers. Example: 30.

display.description: Higher-timeframe RSI(14) above 70 — overbought on the higher timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe RSI has climbed into overbought territory — durable, slower mean-reversion short setup.
info.fires: Triggers when HTF RSI > threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold HTF RSI sits.
info.bestFor: Swing-short setups when LTF triggers align with HTF overbought regime.
info.watchOut: In secular uptrends HTF RSI can remain >70 for weeks; don't fade major macro trends on this alone.

threshold.description: Higher-timeframe RSI overbought boundary in 0–100 index points; RSI above this value triggers. Example: 70.

display.description: Higher-timeframe price > EMA20 > SMA20 > SMA50 — bullish HTF moving-average stack

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe price stacks above EMA20 > SMA20 > SMA50 — clean macro uptrend.
info.fires: Triggers when HTF price > ema20 > sma20 > sma50. Score scales with the percentage gap (capped, divided by 5).
info.bestFor: Macro trend gate — only take longs on the LTF when HTF alignment confirms the regime.
info.watchOut: Alignment is a state; provides context, not timing. Pair with fresh LTF triggers.

display.description: Higher-timeframe price < EMA20 < SMA20 < SMA50 — bearish HTF moving-average stack

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe price stacks below EMA20 < SMA20 < SMA50 — clean macro downtrend.
info.fires: Triggers when HTF price < ema20 < sma20 < sma50. Score scales with the percentage gap (capped, divided by 5).
info.bestFor: Macro trend gate for shorts — only take shorts on the LTF when HTF alignment confirms.
info.watchOut: State-based; needs an LTF trigger for entry timing.

display.description: Higher-timeframe ADX above 25 — directional trend on the higher timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: ADX above/below threshold — trending versus ranging regime classification.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe ADX is high — durable, large-scale trending regime.
info.fires: Triggers when HTF ADX > threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold ADX sits.
info.bestFor: Enabling trend-following strategies when the macro regime confirms a durable trend.
info.watchOut: Direction-agnostic — pair with HTF MA alignment for direction.

threshold.description: Minimum higher-timeframe ADX value, in index points, for a trending market. Example: 25.

display.description: Higher-timeframe ADX below 20 — range-bound on the higher timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: ADX above/below threshold — trending versus ranging regime classification.

info.detects: Higher-timeframe ADX is low — durable, large-scale range-bound regime.
info.fires: Triggers when HTF ADX < threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold ADX sits.
info.bestFor: Enabling mean-reversion strategies when the macro regime is range-bound.
info.watchOut: A long-running HTF range can break out violently — combine with HTF Bollinger Squeeze (where available) for breakout watch.

threshold.description: Maximum higher-timeframe ADX value, in index points, for a ranging market. Example: 20.

display.description: Lower-timeframe RSI(14) below 30 — oversold on the lower timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Lower-timeframe RSI has fallen into oversold territory — fast, short-horizon mean-reversion setup.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF RSI < threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold LTF RSI sits.
info.bestFor: Timing pullback entries within a higher-timeframe uptrend — the fine-grained trigger the HTF regime lacks.
info.watchOut: LTF oversold is noisy — pair with an HTF trend gate so you fade dips only in the trend direction.

threshold.description: Lower-timeframe RSI oversold boundary in 0–100 index points; RSI below this value triggers. Example: 30.

display.description: Lower-timeframe RSI(14) above 70 — overbought on the lower timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: Relative Strength Index — momentum oscillator on 0–100 detecting overbought/oversold and divergences.

info.detects: Lower-timeframe RSI has climbed into overbought territory — fast, short-horizon mean-reversion short setup.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF RSI > threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold LTF RSI sits.
info.bestFor: Timing rally-fade entries within a higher-timeframe downtrend.
info.watchOut: LTF overbought fires often in strong pushes — confirm against the HTF regime before shorting.

threshold.description: Lower-timeframe RSI overbought boundary in 0–100 index points; RSI above this value triggers. Example: 70.

display.description: Lower-timeframe price > EMA20 > SMA20 > SMA50 — bullish LTF moving-average stack

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Lower-timeframe price stacks above EMA20 > SMA20 > SMA50 — fresh short-horizon uptrend.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF price > ema20 > sma20 > sma50. Score scales with the percentage gap (capped, divided by 5).
info.bestFor: Confirming that momentum has turned up on the fast timeframe before committing to a long.
info.watchOut: Alignment is a state, not a trigger; the LTF flips faster than the HTF — combine the two rungs.

display.description: Lower-timeframe price < EMA20 < SMA20 < SMA50 — bearish LTF moving-average stack

moduleDisplay.description: EMA stack alignment, EMA crosses, and SMA200 position — directional trend confirmation.

info.detects: Lower-timeframe price stacks below EMA20 < SMA20 < SMA50 — fresh short-horizon downtrend.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF price < ema20 < sma20 < sma50. Score scales with the percentage gap (capped, divided by 5).
info.bestFor: Confirming that momentum has turned down on the fast timeframe before committing to a short.
info.watchOut: State-based and fast-flipping; pair with the HTF rung for the dominant direction.

display.description: Lower-timeframe ADX above 25 — directional trend on the lower timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: ADX above/below threshold — trending versus ranging regime classification.

info.detects: Lower-timeframe ADX is high — a fast, short-horizon trending impulse.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF ADX > threshold. Score scales with how far above the threshold ADX sits.
info.bestFor: Confirming a fast breakout has directional force — pair with LTF MA alignment for direction.
info.watchOut: Direction-agnostic and quick to fade; only act when the HTF regime agrees.

threshold.description: Minimum lower-timeframe ADX value, in index points, for a trending market. Example: 25.

display.description: Lower-timeframe ADX below 20 — range-bound on the lower timeframe

moduleDisplay.description: ADX above/below threshold — trending versus ranging regime classification.

info.detects: Lower-timeframe ADX is low — a short-horizon range-bound chop.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF ADX < threshold. Score scales with how far below the threshold ADX sits.
info.bestFor: Enabling short-horizon mean-reversion entries while the fast timeframe is chopping inside an HTF trend.
info.watchOut: A tight LTF range often precedes a fast expansion — watch for the ADX turning up.

threshold.description: Maximum lower-timeframe ADX value, in index points, for a ranging market. Example: 20.

display.description: Bullish MA alignment on the lower, primary, and higher timeframes together — full-stack uptrend confluence

moduleDisplay.description: Cross-timeframe synthesis — full-stack MA alignment and higher-timeframe pullback setups across the lower, primary, and higher rungs.

info.detects: Bullish MA alignment holds on all three timeframes at once — the lower, primary, and higher rungs agree on an uptrend.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF, primary, and HTF bull-alignment signals all fire. Score is the mean of their three scores.
info.bestFor: High-conviction trend continuation longs — every timeframe confirms the same direction.
info.watchOut: Full alignment is a late-stage trend state; raise it deliberately as an alignment premium, not as your only entry.

display.description: Bearish MA alignment on the lower, primary, and higher timeframes together — full-stack downtrend confluence

moduleDisplay.description: Cross-timeframe synthesis — full-stack MA alignment and higher-timeframe pullback setups across the lower, primary, and higher rungs.

info.detects: Bearish MA alignment holds on all three timeframes at once — the lower, primary, and higher rungs agree on a downtrend.
info.fires: Triggers when LTF, primary, and HTF bear-alignment signals all fire. Score is the mean of their three scores.
info.bestFor: High-conviction trend continuation shorts — every timeframe confirms the same direction.
info.watchOut: Full alignment is a late-stage trend state; use it as an alignment premium, not a standalone trigger.

display.description: Higher-timeframe uptrend with a lower-timeframe oversold dip — buy-the-pullback confluence

moduleDisplay.description: Cross-timeframe synthesis — full-stack MA alignment and higher-timeframe pullback setups across the lower, primary, and higher rungs.

info.detects: A higher-timeframe uptrend with a lower-timeframe oversold dip — the classic buy-the-pullback setup.
info.fires: Triggers when the HTF bull-alignment signal AND the LTF oversold signal both fire. Score is the LTF oversold score.
info.bestFor: Timing trend-continuation longs — enter the macro uptrend on a fast-timeframe dip.
info.watchOut: An oversold LTF inside a stalling HTF trend can keep falling — confirm the HTF trend is intact.

display.description: Higher-timeframe downtrend with a lower-timeframe overbought bounce — sell-the-rally confluence

moduleDisplay.description: Cross-timeframe synthesis — full-stack MA alignment and higher-timeframe pullback setups across the lower, primary, and higher rungs.

info.detects: A higher-timeframe downtrend with a lower-timeframe overbought bounce — the classic sell-the-rally setup.
info.fires: Triggers when the HTF bear-alignment signal AND the LTF overbought signal both fire. Score is the LTF overbought score.
info.bestFor: Timing trend-continuation shorts — enter the macro downtrend on a fast-timeframe bounce.
info.watchOut: An overbought LTF inside a weakening HTF downtrend can keep rising — confirm the HTF trend is intact.

display.description: Composite spot CVD rising and outpacing perp CVD — organic accumulation leading derivatives

moduleDisplay.description: Perp-vs-spot order-flow divergence — composite centralized-exchange spot CVD compared against perp CVD via bounded self-normalized rates.

info.detects: Composite spot CVD rising and outpacing perp CVD — organic spot accumulation leading the derivatives market.
info.fires: Triggers when the spot flow rate is positive and exceeds the perp flow rate (bounded self-normalized rates, each capped at ±1). Score is the rate gap, clamped at 1. Suppressed when the previous sample crosses the daily 00:00-UTC anchor.

examples.scenario: spot CVD +20% on its base, perp flat
previous sample crosses the daily anchor

info.bestFor: Early accumulation reads — organic spot demand leading leveraged flow is a durable bullish tell.
info.watchOut: A dead-cat spot uptick during a perp capitulation can print a brief spot-led read — confirm with structure and regime context before sizing.

display.description: Perp CVD rising and outpacing composite spot CVD — leverage-led move without spot confirmation

moduleDisplay.description: Perp-vs-spot order-flow divergence — composite centralized-exchange spot CVD compared against perp CVD via bounded self-normalized rates.

info.detects: Perp CVD rising and outpacing composite spot CVD — a leverage-led push without organic spot confirmation.
info.fires: Triggers when the perp flow rate is positive and exceeds the spot flow rate (bounded self-normalized rates, each capped at ±1). Score is the rate gap, clamped at 1. Suppressed when the previous sample crosses the daily 00:00-UTC anchor.

examples.scenario: perp CVD +20% on its base, spot flat

info.bestFor: Fragility reads — leverage-led rallies without spot confirmation are prone to sharp unwinds.
info.watchOut: Divergence marks fragility, not an instant reversal — perp-led moves can extend before unwinding.
